name: As­tral Vul­ture's Crim­son Plum­age
passiveDesc: For 12s after triggering a Swirl reaction, ATK increases by 48%. In addition, when 1/2 or more characters in the party are of a different Elemental Type from the equipping character, the DMG dealt by the equipping character's Charged Attacks is increased by 40/96% and Elemental Burst DMG dealt is increased by 20/48%.
